name: speckit-auto-ai
description: Fully automatic AI-powered markdown-to-PDF documentation generation for VS Code
author: Speckit Team

speckit.backendUrl.description: Backend API URL for document processing

speckit.autoProcess.description: Automatically process markdown files on save

speckit.includePatterns.description: Glob patterns for files to include in auto-processing

speckit.excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude from processing

speckit.apiKey.description: API key for backend authentication - must match SPECKIT_EXT_API_KEY in infra/docker-compose.yml (dev-key by default). Empty defeats auth entirely (no Authorization header is sent), so every backend call 401s.

speckit.enableDebugLogging.description: Enable verbose debug logging (may log sensitive content)

speckit.debounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds for file change events

speckit.maxConcurrentProcessing.description: Maximum number of files to process concurrently

speckit.allowRuleBasedFallback.description: Allow falling back to a lower-quality rule-based transform when no AI provider is available or the AI request fails. When off (default), processing fails with a clear error instead, so you notice and fix AI availability rather than silently getting a degraded PDF/board.

speckit.enableCopilotProgressTracking.description: Auto-provision .github/copilot-instructions.md (and a .gitignore entry) with live task-progress-tracking instructions in Speckit projects, and watch for the resulting signal files, so the Kanban board can show a task as "In Progress" while Copilot works on it, not just "Done" once its checkbox is saved.

speckit.preferredModelId.description: Substring (case-insensitive) matched against the id/family/name of the Copilot models available to this extension, e.g. "gpt-4o" or "o1" - if it matches, that model is tried first instead of whichever one Copilot returns by default. Leave empty to use the default. See "Speckit: Show Extension Logs" for the exact ids/families available in your session.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
